title: Rat Bat
summary: +1 greatclub grants Advantage on attack rolls against Beasts.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d8 + 1 Bludgeoning plus Strength. +1 attack rolls. Simple, two-handed greatclub, Dippable, 5 ft melee. This greatclub lacks Tenacity.
fields.Rat Catcher: Advantage on attack rolls against Beasts.
fields.Acquisition: Leaning against the wall by Thisobald Thorm in the Waning Moon.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action, normal weapon damage. Constitution save against the higher of spell save DC or weapon-action DC +2. Failure Dazes for 2 turns, removing Dexterity AC bonus, giving Disadvantage on Wisdom saves, and blocking spending Reaction points. Help clears it. Once per Short Rest with proficiency.
fields.Base value: 190 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
